learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will identify and use different types of adverbs: Manner (How), Place (Where), Time (When), and Frequency (How often).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Verbs love to act, but Adverbs tell us the 'secrets' of the action! They answer the questions: How? Where? When? and How often? Let's become Adverb Detectives! 🕵️‍♀️

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Adverbs of Manner tell us HOW an action is done. They usually come after the main verb and very often end in '-ly'.
examples_or_templates: The turtle walked slowly. (How did it walk? Slowly)
She sang beautifully. (How did she sing? Beautifully)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Adverbs of Place tell us WHERE the action happens (here, there, everywhere, outside, inside). Adverbs of Time tell us WHEN the action happens (today, tomorrow, yesterday, soon, later).
examples_or_templates: Place: The kids are playing outside. (Where? Outside)
Time: I will finish my homework soon. (When? Soon)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Adverbs of Frequency tell us HOW MANY TIMES or how often an action happens. They usually come before the main verb.
examples_or_templates: I always brush my teeth at night. (How often? Always)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ In the sentence 'He never eats spicy food', what type of adverb is 'never'?
❓ Which word is an Adverb of Place?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Find the adverb of manner in this sentence: 'The brave knight fought fiercely.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the word ending in '-ly' that answers 'How?'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add an adverb of time to complete the sentence: 'We are going to the zoo ______.'
subjective_practice.hint: When are you going? (e.g., today, tomorrow)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Sort these adverbs into their correct types: happily, there, sometimes, now.
subjective_practice.hint: Match them to How, Where, How often, and When!

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎬 The Adverb Charades
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Pick an action (like eating or walking). Now do it 'quickly', then 'slowly', then 'happily'. Ask a family member to guess the adverb you are acting out!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Adverbs of Manner tell us HOW an action is done (loudly, neatly).
⭐ Adverbs of Place and Time tell us WHERE (inside) and WHEN (tomorrow).
⭐ Adverbs of Frequency tell us HOW OFTEN an action happens (always, sometimes).
